## Interpretation
Each publication page includes the paper's abstract, bibliographic identifiers, technical summary, stated evidence, applicability and limitations. The publisher's DOI page is the authoritative version of record. Do not conflate simulations with physical-robot experiments. The index separately marks preprints and working papers.
